card.name: Digit 2 in CYP enzyme names
card.fires_on: The digit 2 (sometimes 3 or 8) right after CYP in cytochrome enzyme names such as CYP2B6 or CYP2C19. Also a single digit in clock times or dose schedules.

modes.label: CYP family number
modes.description: The digit 2 right after CYP, before a letter and subfamily number.

modes.description: A single-digit hour before a colon or o'clock in a schedule.
